items.title: Congruent cuspforms give congruent adjacent critical Rankin-Selberg L-value ratios with ramified local factors
items.author: P. Narayanan; A. Raghuram
items.difficulty_reason: The main congruence requires integral rank-one Eisenstein cohomology on GL4: Gorenstein Hecke algebras yield congruent integral GL2 cohomology classes, parabolic/double-coset and lattice constructions control induced representations, and the Eisenstein intertwining operator compares adjacent Rankin-Selberg critical values with explicit local factors and archimedean periods. Complete original weight, critical-range, residual irreducibility and excluded-prime hypotheses retained. Old double-coset reduction lemma is support, not this global arithmetic theorem. Other main formulations and local applications retained context without further counts.

primary.label: Complete original main classical critical-ratio congruence with all assumptions/local factors
